d: Long, braided crimson hair with a single thick plait draped over one shoulder and short bangs framing the face. Sharp, almond-shaped eyes of a bright sky-blue shade, set on a youthful, mature face. A slender, athletic build wearing a dark navy and gold outfit consisting of a gold-sleeved top with a lace-up chest, a white fabric sash at the waist, and form-fitting navy trousers with gold buckles and white-tipped boots. Signature details include two small white horns protruding from the forehead, a large fluffy golden-yellow tail, and a white capelet draped over the shoulders.
